verdict.rationale: Travel booking with automatic price-drop rebooking is a plausible feature for a business cards and spend product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions travel booking, fare or hotel rate monitoring, or rebooking. The FX rate lock (wise-docs-8) protects currency exchange rates on transfers, not booked travel prices, so it is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
